context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about traffic regulation
purpose: Teach: 交通省/官邸/直線/遠隔/無関心/団地/下降/上流

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 交通省と連携した安全策、新直線道路で試行中です。
lines.en: Safety measures coordinated with the transport ministry are currently being tested on the new highway.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Steady pacing, clear diction. The tone of someone briefing a colleague—informative without performance. Slight weight on 'being tested' to ground the reality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 官邸主導の重点政策ですか。
lines.en: Is this a cabinet-level priority initiative?
lines.style: Genuine intellectual curiosity. Slight lean forward in the question. Not challenging, but wanting to understand the scope. A pause before asking, as if placing the pieces.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。地方団地の住民は無関心になりがちで、説明会も遠隔形式に。
lines.en: Yes. Residents in these complexes tend to check out, so we've shifted the briefings to remote format.
lines.style: Measured explanation, slight undertone of resignation. Matter-of-fact about the apathy. Not blaming, just stating operational reality. Pace steady, almost bureaucratic in its acceptance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 参加率の下降は、上流の自治体でも見られますか。
lines.en: Do you see the same drop-off in participation at higher administrative levels?
lines.style: Thoughtful, exploratory. Ren working through the implications as he speaks. A slight pause before 'higher levels,' checking his own framing. Intellectually engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Brief, conclusive. A small nod in the voice. Recognition passing between them—the understanding that some things transcend location. Warm but not effusive.
